question.text: Which one of the following is used to remove most of plutonium from spent nuclear fuel?

solution.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> oxidises plutonium to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>PuF</mi><mn>6</mn></msub></math> and the reaction is used to removing plutonium as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>PuF</mi><mn>6</mn></msub></math> from spent nuclear fuel.
